committed_capex_aud_m.note: REPLACES A$1,210m WITH THE AUDITED COMMITMENTS NOTE, and the direction is favourable so the reasoning has to hold on provenance alone. The field is defined as CONTRACTED, non-deferrable spend. Note 19(a)(ii) of the audited FY26 financial report gives exactly that: capital projects and joint arrangement commitments of A$146.411m within one year plus A$75.525m between one and five years, A$221.936m total. The whole A$221.936m is charged inside the two-year window even though part of it runs past FY28 — apportioning it is forbidden and over-charging is the safe direction, so horizon_years is 2.0. The A$1,210m it replaces was a sum of four BOARD-APPROVED project totals (Northparkes E22 A$545m, Cowal A$430m, Ernest Henry Bert A$160m, Northparkes CPF A$75m) assembled by hand across two statements ten months apart, and this record had ALREADY withdrawn the claim that they were contracted — the June quarterly showed the E22 mining contract still out to tender. Board approval is not a contract, the audited note is, and CYL is recorded on this identical basis (Note 17, capital contracted but not provided for). THE MATERIAL CONSEQUENCE: EVN now survives Gate 2 on cash alone rather than only by drawing its revolver, which retires the standing note that gate2.count_undrawn_facilities decides this name. The A$1,210m of board-approved project capital does not disappear — it is the execution-capital input for the §12.2 item 6 denominator migration, where it is admissible as an UPPER_BOUND.

FY26 non-sustaining capital actually spent was A$142m (Diggers presentation footnote 1), which is a spend rate, not a remaining balance, and is not substituted.
